70050000075598.description: Use this pass to upgrade the game from the Nintendo Switch™ version to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition.
70050000075598.name: Another Eden Begins - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70010000098048.description:
Flamecraft is a cozy, turn-based strategy board game for 1 to 5 players. Become a Flamekeeper and help artisan dragons and shopkeepers delight the townspeople with their craft. Gather and manage resources, enhance the shops by casting enchantments, and become the Master of Flamecraft.

Enter a cozy, vibrant world inhabited by dragons

Flamecraft is set in a fantasy world, in which dragons and magic are part of the ordinary. Here, you’ll meet the adorable artisan dragons, who will use their extraordinary flamecraft to help the town’s shopkeepers with their seemingly mundane tasks. 
The sweets are just waiting to be baked in Guilty Treasures, and Scale Mail Post is ready to send enchanted letters all across the town!

Master the art of resource management and create powerful combos to increase your reputation

You’ll have to strategize and outsmart other Flamekeepers if you want to come out on top. There are countless ways to victory, and it’s up to you to make the most of your skills. Your main task is to thoughtfully place dragon artisans in the town’s bustling shopping district. They will help you gather various resources from the shops, which you can later use to cast enchantments, triggering powerful ability combos. You’ll also befriend the extraordinary Fancy Dragons, with abilities allowing you to boost your reputation.
This, along with the Companion cards, which offer powerful additional scoring opportunities, will let you get the reputation points needed to win the game.

Play in a variety of gameplay modes, both single and multiplayer 

Whether you prefer playing solo, with friends, or people from around the world, Flamecraft has something in store for you. Test your skills against AI of varying difficulty or set up a relaxing custom game for your family to enjoy together.

Meet over 70 beautiful animated dragons and visit 30 unique shops while listening to a whimsical score

In Flamecraft, we’ve brought the enchanting world created by Sandara Tang to life. The beautifully illustrated dragons come to life as they use their craft in the vibrant, hand-painted town, full of animated 3D shops, booths, and laboratories. 
Paweł Górniak, the composer behind Wingspan and Quilts and Cats of Calico, is also back, with another spellbinding score.

Will you be able to claim the Master of Flamecraft title with the help of your creative little crafter friends?
70010000098048.intro: Flamecraft is a 1-5 player cozy strategy game filled with magic.
70010000098048.name: Flamecraft

70010000100309.description:
Dive into the story of Nanoca Flanka's revitalization of Tristia! 

The beautiful city of Tristia, nicknamed the "Jewel of the Sea," once bustled with maritime trade until recent dragon attacks stripped the city of its charm, and the people have resigned to its state of decay.

Tristia: Legacy is a city building simulation game where you play as crafter-inventor Nanoca Flanka, who has been challenged to restore the city within a year. Research and create new items for vendors, fulfill invention requests and build new facilities to help revitalize the city's economy. Enjoy a passionate story that unfolds based on your actions on your journey to bring back Tristia's luster.
70010000100309.name: Tristia: Legacy

70010000100726.description:
Nanoca Flanka's battle to revitalize the floundering city of Tristia begins! 

The beautiful city of Tristia, nicknamed the "Jewel of the Sea," once bustled with maritime trade until recent dragon attacks stripped the city of its charm, and the people have resigned to its state of decay.

Tristia: Restore takes place alongside the story of Tristia: Legacy, but focuses on the day-to-day running of Nanoca’s shop. She has some major crafting projects to complete, but while she works to finish them, a constant barrage of requests pour in. Quickness counts as you gather materials, choose the right equipment, and deliver the necessary items for each level. Can you accomplish everything before time runs out?
70010000100726.name: Tristia: Restore

70010000107510.description:
In Mr. Sleepy Man, you play as a sleepy guy who's up way past his bedtime and out of control!

The citizens of Bedtime Town don’t stand a chance! Make a mess of everything you find and turn the entire town against you!
Mr. Sleepy Man features a fully expressive 3D platformer moveset. Jump, glide, and dive your way through interconnected levels that encourage exploration and experimentation.

Interactivity is key! You can pick up and play with every item you find. You’ll need to use the environment to your advantage if you want to create chaos and find every secret this game has to offer!
Your actions will have consequences! NPCs will remember how you've treated them. Friendly faces won't last long when you're up to no good, so be wise! 

Bedtime Town's cast of outrageous characters have their own independent logic. These aren't copy + paste NPCs. Each one of these characters responds in a different way that reflects their own personality!
Mr. Sleepy Man features an interconnected world filled with secrets for the player to explore. With over 350 objectives to complete (including collectables), you'll easily get lost finding every nook and cranny this game has to offer.
With a fully original soundtrack composed and performed by the developer, Mr. Sleepy Man delivers a soundscape that blends nostalgic homages to classic 3D platformers with the raw, melodic edge of early 2000s alternative rock.

List of features:
- A one-of-a-kind soundtrack written and performed by the developer. 
- Over 350 objectives to complete! (Including collectables)
- Chaos simulator gameplay!
- Immersive environments, unhinged characters, and interactive NPCs.
- Fluid character movement!
- SLEEP BUTTON! Go to sleep at any time!
70010000107510.intro: Mr. Sleepy Man is up way past his bedtime and out of control! This sandbox adventure is filled with comical hijinks, outrageous characters, and platforming action!
70010000107510.name: Mr. Sleepy Man

70010000107709.description:
Condo is a quiet, short, and atmospheric first-person exploration game. You wander through an apartment complex at night, meet its residents, and uncover hidden stories.

Playtime:  ≈ 30 minutes.
Finding all events unlocks an ending.
No rush. No destination. ♥
70010000107709.intro: Unable to sleep, you navigate a quiet condo complex. There's no rush - just you, the building, its inhabitants, and the stories they hold.
70010000107709.name: Condo

70010000110142.description:
Maestro is an easy-to-learn hard-to-master rhythm game that turns you into an orchestra conductor. With precise Joy-Con™ motion controls, every gesture matters. You don’t just play the music: you conduct it.

Explore a curated repertoire spanning movies and gaming soundtracks, classical and jazz music bringing together the most iconic works in music History. Conduct scores from Star Wars, Game of Thrones, The Lord of the Rings, Harry Potter, and Attack on Titan and the timeless masterpieces of Beethoven, Mozart, Wagner, Vivaldi, and Duke Ellington.

Step into the Parisian artistic society and discover music, culture and gastronomy where real orchestra conducting meets griping rhythm gameplay. Set the tempo, cue the instruments, guide the crescendos, and lead every performance in real time.

Are you ready to become a true Maestro?
70010000110142.intro: Grab your Joy-con™ and throw real Maestro moves
70010000110142.name: Maestro

70010000111685.description:
AU REVOIR - 2071

In a future where immortality is a privilege of the wealthy, Au Revoir Ltd. dominates the market with synthetic brains capable of storing human consciousness. Sentinels are tasked with locating these minds and carrying out the recovery and transfer process into new bodies.

Explore interactive environments, collect documents and clues, solve unique puzzles, and make decisions that influence the course of the story. Use your car to navigate different areas and interact with characters who hide more than they reveal.

ENGAGING NARRATIVE

Experience a rich and complex story where the narrative unfolds with depth, filled with twists and moral dilemmas that challenge your view of the world and of the protagonist.

IMMERSIVE SETTING

Explore a carefully crafted futuristic world with detailed environments and striking visual design. The neon-noir atmosphere blends vibrant colors with a dense mood, creating a deeply immersive cyberpunk setting.

DEEP CHARACTERS

Interact with a variety of characters, each with their own personality, motivations, and hidden secrets. Conversations reveal crucial details and open up different paths, adding weight to every encounter and multiple ways to interpret what’s truly happening.

INVESTIGATIVE CHALLENGES

Face puzzles that require logic, observation, and attention to detail. Gather clues, connect information, and solve narrative-driven challenges. Each solved mystery brings you closer to the truth — or to new questions to uncover.

Prepare for an unforgettable journey in Au Revoir, where every decision can alter the fate of the world.
70010000111685.intro: The year is 2071. As Tristan, you have to uncover secrets and solve puzzles to recover human consciousnesses in this neon-noir world with a low poly aesthetic inspired by the 90s.
70010000111685.name: Au Revoir

70010000117150.description:
An Unlikely Alliance

Adventures are better together… even when they don’t start that way.

In a distant corner of the Kingdom, two enterprising young souls, Moira and Adrius, find themselves in over their heads when a heist goes wrong, accidentally binding their fate to that of the realm’s greatest heroes.

Now together with Amadeus, Zoya, and Pontius, the unlikely party must journey across perilous fantasy landscapes and overcome mounting challenges to restore a powerful magic gone awry before a dangerous warlock closes in to reclaim what is his.

Perplexing Puzzles

Trine 6’s puzzles are designed with a co-op-first approach, encouraging players to work together, coordinate actions, and combine abilities to progress. All puzzles can be solved by any character, giving players the freedom to choose their characters based on preferred playstyle rather than hardcoded puzzle requirements.
For those who prefer to go it alone, updated puzzle designs also allow solo players to take on the challenges themselves.

Shared Adventure

Play with up to four players and share every moment of the adventure together. Work through challenges, celebrate shared victories, and laugh through the occasional bit of chaos with friends on the same couch or across the world via crossplay.

Take Your Time

All characters can make use of the brand-new Time-Slow ability for a bit of extra control when it matters most. Slow down the world around you to help line up precise jumps, react to threats, dodge incoming attacks, or just provide some breathing room in the most chaotic moments.

Dynamic Combat

Dodge incoming strikes, find openings, and focus your attacks while adapting to enemies with distinct abilities, including those that shield or strengthen their allies. Combat and movement go hand in hand, requiring positioning, timing, and coordination to succeed.
Boss encounters push these skills even further, blending combat, traversal, and environmental challenges into memorable trials."
Discover Secrets

Venture through a vibrant, handcrafted fantasy world filled with hidden paths and secrets waiting to be uncovered. Explore each level carefully to find rewards to help power up your heroes.

Five Unique Heroes

Trine 6 features five playable characters: three returning favorites and two brand new to the series. Each character offers a distinct playstyle and unlockable skills:
•	Amadeus the Wizard: Summon objects and manipulate the world with magic.
•	Zoya the Thief: Fire arrows at foes and use a rope to traverse and interact with the environment.
•	Pontius the Knight: Crush enemies with a hammer and use his shield to defend and propel allies.
•	Moira the Acrobat: Chain together fluid kick combos and swing through the world using her ribbon.
•	Adrius the Squire: Wield a spear in combat or plant it to create platforms for traversal.
70010000117150.intro: Trine 6: Together in Time is a co-op puzzle platformer for 1–4 players. Wit, timing, and teamwork collide in the next adventure through this fantasy world.
70010000117150.name: Trine 6: Together in Time

70010000117868.description:
The Fountain of Youth was hidden away. Nonetheless, it is fated that a Usurper will slay the Ageless and unearth it once more.

FOUNTAINS is a soulslike action-RPG built around fighting your way through a maze-like interconnected, seamless world. You'll take the role of a hooded stranger, recently imprisoned by a tyrannical regime. Will you escape and uncover the mysteries of this war-torn empire? 

Demanding, but fair combat
Tight, responsive combat puts every tool and tactic in your arsenal to the test, rewarding precision and quick thinking. Your enemies will hit hard and punish hesitation, turning each fight into an intense back-and-forth where the tide of battle can shift in an instant. Adjustable difficulty settings let you feel that thrill at exactly the intensity you crave, no matter your experience.

Exploration that rewards curiosity
The world of FOUNTAINS is one, seamless, giant dungeon. It is a tightly packed labyrinth which twists and loops back on itself. You'll always discover something new:  items, powers and upgrades to unlock new parts of the world.

Leave Your Mark
FOUNTAINS features an online message system. Leave hints throughout the world to help out your fellow players, or trick them into doing something foolish!

- Souls-like action combat set in a metroidvania-style interconnected world.
- Find new abilities and tools to help you to defend yourself and to traverse the world.
- Rich dark fantasy lore told through exploration and environmental storytelling.
- Online message system for community interaction.
- Secrets are everywhere, so always keep an eye out!
70010000117868.intro: Master high-skilled combat and explore a vast, interconnected world.
70010000117868.name: FOUNTAINS

70010000120176.description:
After quelling the coup d'état that shook the Kingdom of Liberl, Estelle and Joshua have finally become senior bracers. However, on the eve of the Queen's Birthday Festival, Joshua reveals the dark truth of his past before vanishing into the night, leaving only his brief farewell: "Goodbye, Estelle." Armed with Joshua's harmonica and an unshakable determination, Estelle embarks upon a continent-spanning quest to find her partner.

During her journey, she must take on the sinister society of Ouroboros as it emerges from the shadows to plunge Liberl into utter chaos. The capital in flames. A colossal airship darkens the skies. The looming threat of the Shining Ring... Confronted with the greatest crisis in the history of Liberl, Estelle and her allies battle to find Joshua and untangle the web of intrigue and conspiracy woven by Ouroboros!

Key Features

■ CONTINUE YOUR 1ST CHAPTER JOURNEY
By carrying over your clear data from 1st Chapter, you can obtain exciting bonus items that will let you progress through the story more smoothly.

■ MORE COMBAT OPTIONS THAN EVER BEFORE
Overpower your enemies with new Crafts and S-Crafts! Link your characters' attacks during Quick Battles with the new Brave Rush, and make full use of the orbment system for access to Arts.

■ AN UNFORGETTABLE STORY
Dive into an intricately woven narrative to uncover the conspiracies threatening the Kingdom of Liberl.

■ EXPANSIVE SIDE CONTENT
Enjoy a variety of new content in the sequel, including minigames like fishing and poker, cooking with your companions, and fan-favorite characters joining as playable party members.

Experience the expansive combat system, richly realized world, and stirring story of the 2nd chapter of the Trails series!
70010000120176.intro: Take Fate Into Your Own Hands
70010000120176.name: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter

70010000122899.description:
Meet Dan. Dan has a sniper rifle. Don’t panic, he’s not here to harm anyone. Dan’s a professional and his job is fixing things. From a distance. With pinpoint accuracy and good intentions.

Sniper Dan is a hidden object game unlike any other. Objects aren't always well hidden and the solution involves shooting them. Each job follows a simple and highly respected method.

Figure out the problem. Use the clues. HMM…

Find the problem. Scope the area. AHA!

Fix the problem. Shoot. WHEE!

You’re not hunting enemies. You’re hunting problems. Fixing rusty taps, machines behaving badly and even stop a thieving Pelican. Travel far and wide across lively 3D locations packed with visual jokes and silly situations as you help those in need. Can Dan and his trusty tool get the job done? 
Dan’s business takes him to villages, parks, farms, airports, cities and beyond. Special challenges keep every day fresh. Take on optional work for extra cash, tackle bigger jobs for even bigger rewards and uncover secrets that leave citizens quietly convinced something magical just happened.
It did. It was Dan!

Between contracts, upgrade your rifle, decorate your office hub and grow your entirely legitimate troubleshooting business. Unlock bonus games and extra modes like Time Attack, Ammo Hunt and Photo Mode, all under the judgmental eye of Rank Chook.

Funny, colourful and sure to leave you wanting more, Sniper Dan is about finding what’s wrong, fixing it fast and moving on to the next job.

Scope the problem. Take the shot. Make everyone happy.
70010000122899.intro: A ridiculous, family-friendly 3D Hidden Object game with a big twist.
70010000122899.name: Sniper Dan

70010000128023.description:
Classic literature meets classic gaming in Jane Austen's 8-bit Adventure! This 2D platformer stars Jane Austen herself, the beloved English novelist, who finds herself transported into an 8-bit video game.

Explore 8-bit England, battle characters ripped straight from Austen's novels, and defeat enemies the only way a proper author knows how — with a quill. Collect the scattered pages and restore Miss Austen's books to the 8-bit library before it's too late!

- Battle characters from Jane Austen's novels
- Explore 8-bit England
- Defeat enemies with a quill
- Restore Miss Austen's books to the 8-bit library
70010000128023.intro: She wrote the rules. Now she's breaking them — with a quill.
70010000128023.name: Jane Austen's 8-bit Adventure

70010000133430.description:
Shape Wars is a fast-paced local multiplayer strategy game where geometric armies clash for dominance. Build your base, spawn units, upgrade your forces, and deploy devastating EMPs or pilot a Commander to turn the tide of battle.

Play solo against cunning AI opponents or go head-to-head with up to 4 players in Free For All, Teams, or AI Teams mode. Capture resource points, upgrade damage and shields, and outmaneuver your rivals to be the last shape standing.

Features:
- 1-4 player local multiplayer
- 3 game modes: Free For All, Teams, AI Teams
- 4 unique maps with different resource layouts
- Build barracks, archery ranges, tank factories, and more
- Deploy EMPs to wipe enemy waves
- Pilot a Commander unit with rocket attacks and self-destruct EMP
- Capture resource points for income advantage
- Upgrade damage, shields, and building production
- Procedural sound effects and a neon glow aesthetic
- Quick matches - games last 3-10 minutes
70010000133430.name: Shape Wars

70010000134081.description:
Discover a fresh twist on classic jigsaw puzzles in Jigsaw Puzzle Fun Shapes! Complete 30 colorful and entertaining levels featuring unique puzzle pieces in all kinds of fun and creative shapes.

Each puzzle offers a charming illustration and a new challenge, making every level feel different. With cute artwork, vibrant colors, and relaxing gameplay, it's a delightful experience for players of all ages.

Features:
>30 puzzle levels
>Colorful, cute artwork
>Relaxing gameplay with no time limits
>Suitable for players of all ages
>Easy to pick up and play
70010000134081.name: Jigsaw Puzzle: Fun Shapes

70050000077738.description:
Shattered Shape is an expansion to FOUNTAINS. You will continue your journey across the mysterious and dangerous One Kingdom and uncover the truth of the Usurper’s prophecy through a brand new twisted adventure. 

Delve into the depths of an uncharted land:
The southern Vainlands have long been forsaken and left to rot by the One Kingdom. Though too treacherous for most, the hooded stranger is called to this mystifying region. Explore new dungeons, discover secrets, and face new challenges that await in these accursed lands.

Face mystical and fearsome foes:
Harsh and dangerous new enemies are found in the southern Vainlands. From monsters to misshapen beings, the uncanny roam the open areas in their twisted forms while beasts prowl for their next victim. Many who venture there do not survive, and those who do are never quite the same.

Wield a new, powerful arsenal:
You will find many new powers to help you in your adventure through the south. Use new magical swords to hack your foes, utilise mystical tools to confuse your enemies, and collect unique armour sets to fight with style.

Uncover the truth of the Usurper’s Prophecy:
Throughout your journey across the One Kingdom, a voice calls out and brings you to the harsh lands of the south. While pursuing this call, new faces and personalities will guide you through the Vainlands with mysterious quests and novel insights into the Usurper’s prophecy. Expect the unexpected as you go deeper into the story of these lands.
70050000077738.intro: This is a content expansion for the game FOUNTAINS
70050000077738.name: FOUNTAINS - Shattered Shape

70050000078309.description: Pre-order now to unlock a limited-edition exclusive Baton! Stand out on the podium with a unique cosmetic item available only to early conductors.
70050000078309.name: Pre order bonus

70070000029616.description:
Revitalize Tristia in this updated collection!

The beautiful city of Tristia, nicknamed the "Jewel of the Sea," once bustled with maritime trade until recent dragon attacks stripped the city of its charm, and the people have resigned to its state of decay.

Play as Nanoca Flanka, and revitalize the city—your way.

Build and manage a thriving city in Legacy, where you'll research and create new items for vendors, fulfill invention requests and build new facilities to help revitalize the city's economy. Enjoy a passionate story that unfolds based on your actions on your journey to bring back Tristia's luster.

Or dive into an action-packed adventure in Restore, which focuses on the day-to-day running of the shop. Complete major crafting projects as a constant barrage of requests pour in. Quickness counts as you gather materials, choose the right equipment, and deliver the necessary items for each level. Can you accomplish everything before time runs out?
70070000029616.name: Tristia: Chronicles

70010000130034.description:
FIGHT THE DEAD. SURVIVE THE STREETS.

The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival challenges you to intense arcade brawling in the unforgiving world of AMC’s The Walking Dead.

Play as iconic survivors Rick Grimes, Daryl Dixon, and Michonne while fighting through walker-infested tunnels, devastated settlements, and hostile strongholds packed with explosive encounters. Face Alexandria’s most ruthless foes, the Saviors led by Negan, along with overwhelming waves of Walkers as you unleash crushing combos, signature weapon attacks, and devastating finishers in a relentless battle for survival.

INSPIRED BY THE STORY YOU KNOW. 
Based on the events of the All Out War storyline, fight through a campaign that reimagines the Saviors conflict that features walkers, threats, and surprises pulled from across the world of AMC’s The Walking Dead. You’ll explore familiar environments from the show - including the Sanctuary, Hilltop, Alexandria – enhanced by dynamic set pieces, environmental hazards, and intense, story-driven moments.

ICONIC SURVIVORS. ICONIC WEAPONS.
Step into the boots of legendary characters from The Walking Dead, each with a unique fighting style, stats, and signature abilities inspired by the series. Rick’s magnum, Michonne’s katana, and Daryl’s trusty crossbow are all ready for battle.

FEATURES:
•        Hard-Hitting Arcade Beat ’Em Up Combat
Use brutal melee abilities, crowd-clearing ranged attacks, or a mix of the two in fast-paced skirmishes. Enjoy responsive, crisp, and satisfying fighting gameplay while exploring the apocalypse.

•        Overwhelming Walker Swarms & Ruthless Enemies
Battle through creeping armies of the undead and dangerous members of The Saviors that force you to adapt, assess threats, and fight for every inch of ground.

•        Face Iconic Bosses
Take on powerful, fan-favorite walkers like Winslow, the Well Walker, and more. The Saviors provide their own challenges as you throw down with Negan and Simon in intense, multi-phase boss battles that test your skill, strategy, and survival instincts.

•        Replayable Arcade Challenge
Master each character’s moveset and tackle multiple difficulty levels in an experience built for repeat runs and escalating challenges. Or jump in with an optional Easy Mode for casual play.
70010000130034.intro: Arcade Beat 'Em Up Action in the World of AMC's The Walking Dead
70010000130034.name: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival

70050000077191.description:
The world fell apart. Your weapons don’t have to look like it.

The Golden Survival Pack delivers a full set of premium gold-finished weapon skins for the survivors of AMC’s The Walking Dead. Outfit your arsenal with striking new looks of the iconic weaponry of The Walking Dead. Carve through walkers with Michonne’s katana, drop walkers with Daryl’s crossbow, or unload Rick’s magnum in the middle of a desperate last stand, every fight hits harder when your gear stands out against the ruins of the world.

Battle through the apocalypse with an arsenal forged to shine when everything else has gone dark. The Golden Survival Pack Includes 7 golden skins for iconic character weapons.
70050000077191.intro: Gold-polished gear for brutal fights and last stands.
70050000077191.name: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival - Golden Survival Pack

70050000077195.description:
The Arcade Apocalypse Pack expands the brutal world of AMC’s The Walking Dead with exclusive digital content built for survivors ready to push deeper into the apocalypse.

Push your skills to the limit in Walker Pit - an Endless Survival Mode, where every encounter becomes a desperate battle to stay alive against overwhelming odds. For survivors looking for the ultimate challenge, “Hell on Earth” difficulty strips away checkpoints and leaves no room for mistakes.

Also included are additional weapon & character skins, and the digital soundtrack.

The Arcade Apocalypse Pack includes:
•        2 Weapon Skins - Tactical Magnum and Unlockable Mystery Weapon Skin
•        1 Character Skin - Civic Republic Military Rick 
•        The Walker Pit - Endless Survival Combat Mode
•        HELL ON EARTH Difficulty mode - Hardcore Mode without Checkpoints
•        Digital Soundtrack
70050000077195.intro: More walkers, more game modes, more skins, and more digital bonus content.
70050000077195.name: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival - Arcade Apocalypse Pack

70010000133419.description:
You wake up in a strange place made up of endless red hallways. The exit is only a few steps away, but it's locked. To escape, you'll need to search the maze, solve puzzles, and uncover the key before it's too late.

You're not alone.

Something is wandering the hallways, and it's hunting you.

Features:
>Explore eerie endless red hallways.
>Solve puzzle to unlock the exit.
>Avoid a terrifying creature stalking the maze.
>Experience tense first-person horror.

Escape before it's too late.
70010000133419.intro: The exit is right there... but you can't leave.
70010000133419.name: RED HALLWAY: Horror

70010000133681.description:
Test your parkour skills in a dangerous lava-filled obstacle course packed with moving platforms and deadly traps. Time your jumps carefully and make it to the end of every level without falling into the magma.

Think you've mastered the course? Try Hardcore Mode, where every checkpoint is disabled. One mistake means starting over.

Features
>Complete exciting lava-themed parkour levels.
>Jump across moving platforms and over molten magma.
>Use checkpoints to save your progress.
>Take on Hardcore Mode with no checkpoints.
70010000133681.name: Parkour Obby: Magma Run

70010000094723.description:
COORDINATE OR CRUMBLE! To survive this mission, you'll need to grab a Joy-Con™ and get ready to swing into action. Take control of the inseparable duo, Ten and Tango, as they embark on a high-stakes platforming journey to topple the villainous Chef Murgó.

Don’t let the cute art style fool you—this is a relentless test of skill where one slip-up sends both octos tumbling. Whether you’re tackling the challenge Solo (mastering the "brain-melting" art of controlling both characters at once) or syncing up in Local or Online Co-op, your coordination will be pushed to the absolute limit.

WHY YOU’LL BE TANGLED UP:
DECEPTIVELY DIFFICULT: Master the timing of two octos holding hands. It’s quirky, colorful, and punishingly hard.

TANDEM TEAMWORK: Use your physical bond to swing across massive gaps and dodge lethal traps. In this game, you literally "carry" your partner!

DIVERSE WORLDS: Navigate windy deserts, crumbling lava mountains, and intricate puzzles that demand 100% precision.

PERFECT FOR SWITCH: Play anytime, anywhere in Tabletop, Handheld, or TV mode. One Joy-Con per player is all you need for local co-op!

GLOBAL LEADERBOARDS: Think you’re the fastest on the planet? Prove it! Compete for the best times against players worldwide.

GAME MODES:
* 2-Player Online or Local Co-op: The ultimate test of friendship and physics.
* Solo Mode: A unique mental challenge where you must coordinate both octos simultaneously.
70010000094723.intro: Two octos on a precision mission! Swing through a cute but brutal world. Master the tango of teamwork solo or in local/online co-op. Can you defeat Chef Murgó?
70010000094723.name: Tentacle Tango

70010000105838.description:
Your beloved human has vanished into the night. As a pair of courageous cats, you’ll follow their scent to an abandoned mansion shrouded in fog and mystery. But this is no ordinary house — it’s alive with whispers, shadows, and secrets from the past.

Ghostly Whiskers is a short but unforgettable co-op (or solo) adventure that blends light horror with heartwarming moments. Solve puzzles, explore eerie rooms, and use your feline instincts — like squeezing through tight spaces, climbing ledges, and sniffing out hidden clues — to uncover the truth.

- Use your flashlight to reveal secrets in the dark
- Sniff out trails and memory fragments
- Explore a hand-crafted haunted mansion full of cozy, eerie charm
- Play solo or with a friend in split-screen co-op

Check out this fun new game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team.

In the end, it’s not just about chasing ghosts — it’s about finding your friend… and bringing them home.
70010000105838.intro: Two fearless cats on a cozy, spooky adventure.
70010000105838.name: Ghostly Whiskers

70010000115744.description:
Farming Camp is a cozy, single-player farm management game that follows the journey of an ambitious teenager competing to become the best farmer in the camp. Manage your farm alongside your companions, complete chores for points, and deal with the dynamics of a colorful cast in their teenage years. 

Your path to farming greatness begins!
Step into the boots of young Alessandra, before she became the renowned Evertree Farmer. Experience her life at the Evertree Farming Camp where it all began. Learn the ropes and face the fun and chaos of camp life.

Team up with a lively farming crew
You're not alone on the farm. You’ll have the company of two budding young farmers, each with their own vibe. Assign chores, solve problems, and build friendships as you figure out how to run the farm together.

Heart, humor, and harvests!
Farming’s only half the fun at Evertree Farming Camp. From delightful dramas to silly surprises, and even a few messy moments, there's never a dull day at the camp!

Work hard to take care of the camp
Use the tools at your disposal and climb your way to the top as the camp’s best farming team. Coordinate with your companions and earn points by completing chores, maintaining the camp, attending classes, and tackling missions.  

Have fun and win the competition
Jump into quick and fun minigames that keep things exciting—whether it’s racing against the clock to eliminate pests, chopping wood, cooking delicious meals, and more!

Key Features:
- Embark on a cozy single-player farming adventure and follow a unique, captivating story. 
- Explore a beautifully hand-drawn 2D top-down world full of charming details. 
- Meet a diverse and lovable cast of characters, each with their own quirks, stories, and farming talents. 
- Grow a variety of crops, care for animals, fish, and make your team win the competition.
- Keep your farm thriving with fun and engaging mini-games.
70010000115744.intro: Follow the journey of Alessandra competing to become the best farmer in the camp.
70010000115744.name: Farming Camp

70010000116095.description:
Manage an Adventure Park
 Build all kinds of facilities, such as weapon shops, general stores, and tailor shops, then assign the right Pupus to run them. The harder the heroes “adventure” in your park, the more resources you earn, allowing you to keep expanding your very own adventure park.

Raise the Pupu Clan
 As your park continues to grow, you’ll need more reliable workers. Breed new Pupus through the Spring of Life, build homes for them, and make cookies and cakes to keep them fed—yes, they absolutely love sweets! Of course, you’ll also need to take care of their little moods from time to time.

Unlock Facilities and Blueprints
 From basic shops to special NPCs like bards, merchants, and bounty hunters, keep unlocking blueprints to expand what your park can do. As construction goes on, you may even stumble upon the surprising story hidden behind this adventure park.

Post Adventure Commissions
 Post all kinds of tasks on the commission board to attract different types of heroes. Design your tasks wisely to maximize park revenue and obtain key resources such as rare items and hero essence, which can be used to upgrade and expand your park.
70010000116095.intro: Run a fantasy theme park where heroes get to play adventurer!
70010000116095.name: PUPU's Adventure Park

70010000117652.description:
Conrad wakes up in a hotel room with no memory of who he is or how he got there. What he does know: a deadly virus is tearing through cyberspace, Ankh Industries is behind it, and the clock is already ticking.

Navigate the cyberpunk streets of the City as Conrad, a rogue Courier piecing together the truth. Take on jobs from shady employers, pickpocket and loot to earn credits, and spend them on better guns, stronger armor, and high-tech upgrades. Hack your way through security systems using an intricate beam puzzle minigame, and dig deeper into the conspiracy threatening to bring the whole city down.

- Explore a richly detailed cyberpunk city in a brand new 8-bit adventure
- Earn and spend credits on weapons, armor, and tech upgrades
- Hack security systems with an intricate beam puzzle minigame
- Unravel the mystery behind Ankh Industries and the Courier virus
70010000117652.intro: He woke up with nothing. The city is about to have the same problem.
70010000117652.name: Courier

70010000122475.description: Craft barricades and turrets with whatever you can find. But beware: relentless waves of enemies are coming to tear down everything you build.
70010000122475.intro: Physics meets tower defense in this chaotic party game.
70010000122475.name: Hack 'n' Stack

70010000123873.description:
WELCOME TO LEMURIA
A world inspired by Madagascar’s folklore. Once a paradise, it now suffers under the witch Raneny’s ruthless rule. Having grown tired of exploiting its people, she decided to host a huge concert with the island’s most famous band. You’re sent on a mission to fight back by rallying legendary musicians to your cause! 

THE (BOGUS) PROPHECY CHOSE YOU
Dash through diverse biomes across Lemuria, save and befriend funky locals to form your crew, and jump over industrial platforming traps to become Lemuria’s number one band and finally face Raneny!

DANCING THROUGH JOYFUL CHAOS
Defeat Raneny’s minions in fast-paced combat, using hair-based powers and improvised weapons (slippers included) to fight epic and groovy boss battles and free the island! 

HOP ON A FUN MUSICAL ROADTRIP 
Assemble a band with eccentric lemur artists, manage your tour bus through mini-games, and build your band’s popularity among locals to perform on bigger stages.
70010000123873.intro: Kalanoro is an action-adventure mixing platforming, combat and light management!
70010000123873.name: Kalanoro

70010000124353.description:
Every Soldier Has Their Specialty: Draft your forces among a wide variety of unique units, who each have a unique set of skills to exercise on the battlefield. Bully enemies by pushing and pulling them with the hearty Champion, strike and fade with the swift Cavalier, lay devastating traps with the talented Mage, and steal your opponent’s life essence and donate it to your companions as a Vampire healer.

Work Together or Die Alone: Units have complementary skill-sets that enable a pair to accomplish more together than they would alone. Well-coordinated skills can be greater than the sum of their parts!

Take the High Ground: Exploit the terrain on the battlefield to gain the upper hand. Hold defensive positions, close drawbridges on unsuspecting enemies, or launch over walls to outflank your foes.

Mark the Dawn of a New Era: Experience a fully-featured Campaign story that spans the continent, gathering companions to your Mercenary company, and take on challenges that grow ever greater. Fate has great (and terrible) things in store for you and your companions.

Seize Fate (and the Castle)!: Missions can have multiple victory conditions, and you only need to meet one to win! When you’re on the back-foot, look for an opportunity to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat.

Time Your Attacks Wisely: Each faction moves one unit at a time. You’ll have to react to the evolving state of the battlefield as you adapt to the changing situations.
70010000124353.name: Superstar Strategy

70010000129707.description:
Create the ultimate beachfront destination!

A game all about building a beautiful boardwalk.  Start with small stands and grow into a sprawling seaside paradise full of rides, high-end shops and fancy restaurants.


Build your Boardwalk
Dozens of shops to choose from

Build rides, restaurants, and stores, selling everything from sunglasses to vintage video games to sea glass art

Boost your visit rate by building the rides and restaurants people want


Manage your Promenade
Earn rewards as customers visit your shops

Upgrade each shop to bring in more revenue and serve customers faster

Expand your boardwalk and hire entertainers

Launch marketing campaigns to spread the word about your seaside destination


Combine Shops and Rides
Not enough space to serve your customers?  Combine shops to create bigger, better ones that can handle more customers at a time and earn you more money

Dozens of combination recipes to discover - movie theaters, bumper cars and more!


Other Features:
Navigate demand-changing weather events such as smog and rain

Donate to neighboring businesses – and earn rewards in return!

Participate in themed festivals to up your income and draw in big crowds

Invite VIPs and convince them to build their top-tier attractions on your boardwalk
70010000129707.intro: Design and expand your boardwalk by building rides, shops, and restaurants to draw in crowds.
70010000129707.name: Boardwalk Builders

70010000110117.description:
Welcome to The World’s Game in EA SPORTS FC™ 27.

Step into The Grounds‡‡, a social football playground where the streets meet the stadium. From Kickabouts and 1v1s to teaming up with friends in Clubs, connect with renowned football mentors, improve your abilities, and express yourself on and off the pitch.
Feel greater control in every game mode with more fluid, true-to-life gameplay, featuring dynamic corners, enhanced attacking awareness, player-focused defending tailored for competitive play, and more community-driven innovations.
Sign your next star in Manager Career through a rebuilt Transfer Market with realistic player values and active club bidding. Master new negotiation tactics, including performance and buy-back clauses, as Dynamic OVRs reflect player form, morale, and fitness across every club.
Immortalise your dream club in Football Ultimate Team™ with the brand-new FUT Gallery. Curate your favourite Player Items to grow your Gallery Level, earn rewards, and build your Club’s identity throughout the new football season.
Experience unrivalled authenticity in EA SPORTS FC™ 27, with match data from the world’s top leagues powering 21,000+ licensed players.

Wishlist EA SPORTS FC™ 27 today to be notified when pre-order is available. Coming this September.

‡‡The Grounds mode, including Clubs, only available on Nintendo Switch™ 2 version.

This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.
70010000110117.name: EA SPORTS FC™ 27

70010000132612.description:
You enter an abandoned school hoping to uncover the truth behind its mysterious closure. Empty classrooms, silent hallways, and forgotten lockers hide clues to what really happened.

But before you can leave, the doors lock behind you.

Now your only goal is to escape. Explore the school, collect keys and uncover the dark secrets hidden within its walls. Just don't ignore the feeling that you're being watched.

Features:
>Explore a creepy abandoned school.
>Uncover the mystery behind the school's past.
>Experience atmospheric first-person horror.
>Evade the spirits that haunt the halls.
70010000132612.name: Missed Class: Horror

70010000133703.description:
Make your way through an icy obstacle course filled with slippery platforms, long jumps and freezing hazards. Stay focused as you leap across floating platforms and avoid falling into the frozen abyss.

Want a real challenge? Try Hardcore Mode, where every checkpoint is disabled. One slip, and it's back to the beginning.

FEATURES:
>Complete challenging ice-themed parkour levels.
>Jump across floating platforms and frozen terrain.
>Use checkpoints to save your progress.
>Take on Hardcore Mode with no checkpoints.
70010000133703.intro: Can you escape the frozen course?
70010000133703.name: Parkour Obby: Ice Escape

70010000067526.description:
Drop the pickaxe, grab a sword, and charge into a thrilling new adventure in Minecraft Dungeons II. Journey through unexplored lands and mysterious locations, in a quest to stop a new evil from causing chaos in not one, but two worlds! Clash with menacing foes in explosive encounters and fight your way through hordes of mobs that will do everything in their power to stop you from saving the day.  

The challenges will be tougher than ever! Pre-order today and get 2 hero skins, the Twisted cape, and the Twisted chicken pet! What are you waiting for – a crisis is upon us! Will you and your friends rise to meet it?
70010000067526.intro: Minecraft Dungeons II arrives on September 29!
70010000067526.name: Minecraft Dungeons II

70050000073237.description:
Included
Soul Cape
Blub Pet
4 Hero Skins
70050000073237.name: Deluxe DLC

70070000036387.description: Drop the pickaxe, grab a sword, and charge into a thrilling new adventure in the Minecraft Dungeons II Deluxe Edition, featuring unique cosmetics, pre-order cosmetics, and DLC 1+2 (when released)! Journey through unexplored lands in a quest to stop a new evil from causing chaos in not one, but two worlds. Clash with menacing foes in explosive encounters and fight your way through hordes of mobs that will do everything in their power to stop you from saving the day. The challenges will be tougher than ever, so face them solo or with up to 4 players in online or couch co-op. With a crisis upon us, will you and your friends rise to meet it?
70070000036387.intro: Minecraft Dungeons II arrives on September 29!
70070000036387.name: Minecraft Dungeons II Deluxe Edition

70050000046329.description: The Painted Red Crime Scene includes a Location, 6 Suspects, 4 Customisation Items, and 6 Tokens to unlock!
70050000046329.name: Clue - Painted Red

70010000128469.description:
Down Pit is a relaxed mining platform game set across many off-world underground locations. You are a cuboid mining unit with a singular skill set sent out to extract ore from strange underground places.

Dig.
Get Paid.
Upgrade.
Relax, maybe.
Collect.
Go Back Down Pit.
Dig.

Find your favourite location and dig all the ore. Return to Ore Processing and get paid.  All the pit locations from The Depot can be remined infinitely, for free - no unlocks, bail at any time with no penalty. Dig in your favourite mine again and again, and get paid.

Yes to Digging.
Yes to Getting Paid.

No to enemies, combat, secrets, story, unlocks, card games, skill trees, pets, fishing, timers, npc interruptions, never ending dialogue, walls of text, power of friendship, ancient evil force, lost parents, lost items, lost love, missing pets, self-asteem whining, neuroses listing, dot dot dotting, time wasting, anime, pixel art, anime inspired pixel art, faff.

Dig. And Get Paid.

There’s unlimited money to make with just you and all those mining areas to destroy, one block at a time. You arrive ready to mine, all equipment supplied, all ready to work. All the money is yours because only you will mine it out.

Teleport Down Pit is to the left (Dig).
Ore Processing is to the right (Get Paid).

Lots of other utilities are in The Depot but be careful not to get too distracted, some are costly, some will drain your time. Warning: the poker game does not work and never will (it is a long term programming issue caused by a fool).

Dig. And Get Paid.
70010000128469.name: Down Pit

70010000130716.description:
1. Hatch Eggs: Obtain juvenile monsters of random rarities
2. Raise Monsters: Wait for juvenile monsters to grow up
3. Sell Monsters: Sell monsters after they mature
4. Collect: Complete 100 × 2 monster handbook entries
5. Music: Enjoy relaxing Lo-fi music while idling
6. Offline Progress: Monsters continue to grow and earn income even while you're away
70010000130716.intro: A relaxing idle monster collection game (with offline progress). Features 200 monster entries and 10 Lo-fi tracks.
70010000130716.name: Monster Nursery

70050000074804.description:
Expand your bird sanctuary with Wingspan Bird Pack: Birds of Continental Europe, featuring species from across mainland Europe!

Enhance your wildlife preserve with the 25 fan-designed, distinctive European bird cards with unique powers, and listen to their songs with this digital Bird Pack.

Add new favorites to your collection with bird species from diverse European habitats never before seen in Wingspan Digital, and unlock an exclusive player portrait.

Enjoy the variety of familiar and lesser-known species, each with its own call and charm.
70050000074804.intro: Enhance your wildlife preserve with the 25 fan-designed, distinctive European bird cards with unique powers, and listen to their songs with this digital Bird Pack.
70050000074804.name: Wingspan Bird Pack: Birds of Continental Europe

70010000132991.description:
This pack includes the games: Rally Rock ´N Racing and Hypercar Racing.

Rally Rock ´N Racing

In Rally Rock 'N Racing, you’ll enjoy a wide variety of natural environments, such as deserts, snow-covered mountains, forests... where you can show your skill at the wheel, competing against everyone to become the fastest. The game has several modes, such as Championship, Time Trial, Arcade, and 4-player multiplayer.

Hypercar Racing

In Hypercar Racing you'll enjoy the dirtiest, fastest, and most spectacular races at speeds over 200 Mp/h, avoiding multiple collisions against 8 adversaries. The game has different modes, such as Championship, Arcade, and 4-player multiplayer.

Online leader board where you can compare your best times with those of your friends and players from around the world.

Features:

- Wide variety of tracks.
- Multi-player with 4 players.
- Realistic driving physics.
- Lots of Rock 'N Roll music.
 -Online ranking
70010000132991.intro: Enjoy 2 games in 1 with this irresistible speed games pack!
70010000132991.name: Rally & Hypercar Bundle

70010000133371.description:
You wake up in a dark hallway with no memory of how you got there. The exit is locked by an ancient curse, and the only way to break it is to find every cursed voodoo doll hidden throughout the endless corridors.

But something else roams the halls.

Features
>Explore eerie, cursed hallways.
>Collect voodoo dolls to lift the curse.
>Experience tense first-person horror.
>Survive a terrifying presence stalking the halls.
70010000133371.name: Screaming Halls: Horror

70010000090752.description:
Rainbow Island CS is a collection of several home ports of the arcade game Rainbow Islands.

In addition to the popular 8 and 16-bit versions, the collection includes the never-released-on-cartridge MegaDrive/Genesis version. With 24 quick-save/load slots for each version and a feature that displays the location of the diamonds, there's never been a better time to experience it. Rainbow Islands is an arcade action game released by Taito in 1987 where the player controls Bubby or Bobby, using their rainbow magic as both weapons and platforms to climb and reach the goal at the highest point of each stage.

[Story] 
At the end of the previous game, Bubble Bobble, the bubble dragons Bub and Bob had rescued their parents and girlfriends and returned to their human forms of Bubby and Bobby.
Several years after those events, Bubby and Bobby return to their ancestral home, Rainbow Islands, in search of treasure, but end up entangled in another devious plot!
It seems that their true nemesis, the Boss of Shadow, has since resumed his evil machinations. Bubby and Bobby's path is blocked by various enemies, but with the “rainbow magic” given to them by their parents, they bravely continue their adventurous journey.

■■ About the Game ■■

Heroic Songs: the Remix! is an Idol × City-Building Simulation Game where you help develop a land known as the Void while guiding the main heroine, Akari Sunohara, on her journey to become an idol. Build roads and facilities, attract new residents, and transform this desolate world into a vibrant Fanctuary worthy of the spotlight!

● A Diverse Lineup of Buildings
With over 50 unique buildings, you'll have plenty of ways to shape your city!
- Basic Facilities such as houses to attract Fans, and roads to connect your buildings
- Production Facilities, placed around resource tiles and visited by Fans to gather materials
- Processing Facilities, which convert one type of resource into another as a result of Fan visits
- Recreational Facilities, where resources are spent to generate Likes, a key progression resource
You can also earn Likes through Tours, or the rhythm-based Concerts described below.

● Idol Stages
By constructing personal stages, idols will perform for their Fans by singing and dancing in town! Idols with stages become available for Concerts and Tours, and will boost the surrounding buildings whenever they’re present. 

As idols gain experience from performances, their levels rise—enhancing those building effects even further! You can also assign skill points to customize how their influence spreads across your city. ;)

● Concerts
Concerts are short, 30-second rhythm games. Keep in time with the music to hit the target score and clear the stage! Successful Concerts will unlock new story content, boost idol and Fan experiences, and provide rewards. Some idols will also unlock alternate stage outfits as you progress through the game.

● A Wild Yet Heartfelt Story Unfolds!
Progress through successful concerts, construction projects, and city development to unlock new chapters in the story.
Follow Akari Sunohara—an ordinary girl with a love for idols—as she discovers her true calling. Dive deeper into each of the five main heroines in dedicated Character Stories, and experience each idol’s unique charm!

■ Characters ■
● Protagonist (You)
You’re the one who was transported to the Void alongside Akari. As the central figure in this world, your role is to support Akari and the other idols on their journey.

● Akari Sunohara / voiced by: Seika Hirose
An ordinary girl with an extraordinary love for idols. She possesses the innate potential to become one herself, and must step into the spotlight to find a way home.
At first, she struggles with doubt and frustration, but grows through her encounters with veteran idols and her fans in the fantasy worlds.

● Ruri Tsukuyomi / voiced by: Risae Matsuda
The Ultimate Idol, reigning at the top with an overwhelming presence and voice. Her legacy echoes throughout the various fantasy worlds Akari explores.

● Lynalelle Singulant / voiced by: Hitomi Sekine
The idol of Seven Falls, a fantasy-themed world. She’s a king, an idol, and a passionate idol superfan all in one!

● Haru / voiced by Yuka Amemiya
The idol of Discordia, a sci-fi-themed world. She’s a trusted senior to Akari, but seems to be hiding some complicated circumstances.

● Kaguya / voiced by Risae Matsuda
The idol of Karan Ashihara, a world with a traditional Japanese aesthetic. As the wild and fearsome Behemoth of Befoulment, she stands in Akari’s path as a powerful rival.

The Witch's Bakery is a cozy Adventure RPG about a joyful witch who opens her bakery in modern Paris. She has one special power: she can see into people's heart and heal emotions through magic!

YOUR DAILY LIFE AS A WITCH-BAKER IN PARIS!
You play as Lunne, who has just arrived in the city! Each day is split into three phases:

- Daytime, where Lunne manages her bakery and serves clients with her team of friends.
- Evening, where Lunne explores Paris, builds relationships, discovers the city's secrets and goes inside her friends' troubled heart.
- Night, where Lunne rests, improves her magic, decorates her bakery and spends time in her cosy atelier.

The story progresses through the days as you earn experience, money, and fame, meet new friends and heal their heart.

A COLORFUL PARIS IN A JOYFUL ADVENTURE!
Once your work day is done, you can visit several districts of Paris to meet with main characters, engage in activities to learn new skills, buy books for new recipes, etc.
From typical streets of famous districts like Montmartre and the Grands Boulevards, to more intimate promenades known only by locals, Paris has many wonders to discover.Each district has its own characters, activities and shops!

A STORY ABOUT EMOTIONS AND VULNERABILITY
For some people, their emotion is locked away so strongly than Lunne needs to go inside their heart to help them. She enters their "Heart Palace", a magical space where emotions and thoughts take shape. Lunne needs to guide the personified Emotion back to the heart. Inside the Heart Palace, Lunne discovers the person's deepest struggles and finds the key ingredient she needs to make a bread that will heal them!

70010000109108.description:
Step back into Andy’s room with Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and more classic characters in Toy Story: Retro Roundup! This five-game collection features console and handheld versions of four early Toy Story titles, as well as A Bug’s Life. All the games have been upgraded with new features, quality-of-life improvements, and an overflowing toy chest of behind-the-scenes content. Revisit the ‘90s and early 2000s hits you loved and share these titles with a new generation of Toy Story fans. 

Play Toy Story (1995), Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue! (1999), Toy Story 2 (1999), Buzz Lightyear of Star Command (2000), Toy Story Racer (2001) and A Bug’s Life (1998). Unlock game-specific enhancements like unlimited lives or invincibility with Rex’s Cheat Codes.

Explore a richly-detailed virtual museum filled with rare design documents, vintage development photos, and archival content. Listen to your favorite songs from the games in the Music Player, where we’ve rounded up the soundtracks from every game in the collection. 

FEATURES

- Play five classic games, including four Toy Story games and A Bug’s Life. Includes 11 total versions of the games across console and handheld.

- Enhancements and quality-of-life improvements make the games easier to learn and understand for gamers of all ages. 

- Use Rewind to fix your mistakes. Messed up a jump? Took too many hits? Simply hold a button and scrub back to before you made that mistake and try again. 

- Includes a behind-the-scenes experience featuring new interviews with Jason Katz – Head of Story, Pixar, Jim Hanks – Voice Actor, Luigi Priore – VP and GM, Disney & Pixar Games, and Jon Burton – Founder, TT Games. 

- Explore the virtual museum filled with rare design documents, vintage development photos, and archival content.

- Listen to the Music Player, which includes the complete soundtrack for every game in the collection.

70010000109113.description:
Reopen the toy chest and saddle up as Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie in Toy Story 3 Complete Edition, a 3D adventure based on the hit 2010 animated film, Toy Story 3. The updated game features improved graphics and a few new surprises in store. Play through authentic moments from the movie in Story Mode, or drop into the wild west sandbox of Woody’s Roundup in Toy Box Mode. 

In Story Mode, swap between Woody, Buzz, and Jessie as you play through iconic scenes from the film, including the train rescue, Operation Playtime, surviving the junkyard, and more. Harness each character's unique abilities, whether you need to swing on Woody’s pull string or use Buzz’s strength to throw the other toys long distances. You can even play in two-player co-op. 

Step out of Story Mode and into the sandbox in Toy Box Mode. This fan-favorite, customizable mode drops you into the wild west of Woody’s Roundup. Like Story Mode, you play as Woody, Buzz, or Jessie, but in Toy Box Mode you can play however you want! Characters around town give you quests to complete, so you can earn gold and spend it on personalizing the town your way. Build, decorate and customize the buildings, dress up the townsfolk, and more.

Toy Story 3 Complete Edition also includes content that was previously restricted to certain versions of the game. Players can now play as the Evil Emperor Zurg in Toy Box Mode, and can access four additional Theme Packs to decorate their Toy Box. Toy Story 3 Complete Edition also features upgraded graphics, resolution, and framerate.

FEATURES

- Toy Story 3 Complete Edition brings back a fan-favorite game. 

- Relive key moments from the movie in Story Mode from Andy's room to Sunnyside Daycare.

- Swap between Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie, each of with different abilities you’ll need to complete each level. 

- Dive into the sandbox in Toy Box Mode. Take on missions for your fellow toys, dress up the townsfolk, decorate buildings, and much more. 

- Play with a friend in local, two player co-op. Available in Story Mode or Toy Box Mode. 

- All versions now include previously exclusive content, such as the ability to play as Emperor Zurg in Toy Box Mode.

70010000100154.description:
What is Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure?
A single-player, tilt-based platformer game for everyone. A heartwarming physics-based adventure for all ages. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

Why do we need Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure?
Marupoyo is a charismatic, simple alternative to complex heroes, featuring a clean art style perfect for all ages. It offers the ideal mix of relaxing vibes and fun challenges. It's a unique game for everyone to enjoy alone or with the family.

What kind of players can enjoy the game?
The game is designed for everyone, having an easy  accessibility in the controls (just need to tilt the controller to play!) and with only one action: brake. Also, the Family Mode adds elements to avoid players dying, allowing players that like cozy games to play and have fun. However, the gamer mode brings more speed, deathly elements and adds lots of challenges to the game, such as beating the clock, getting the badge for not losing lives or the Pro player badge for not using brakes.

Story Summary
Marupoyo is a unique chick born so round he can’t walk — he can only roll! Though initially mocked for his clumsiness, he becomes the village’s only hope when a massive tornado scatters his family across the kingdom.

Guided by the Queen of Nature, Marupoyo rolls through forests, icy mountains, sandy deserts and volcanoes to stop an exiled Alchemist whose experiments are destroying the world. Along the way, he rescues his siblings and proves that his unique way of moving is actually a superpower - always rolling forward! Without fear, he will restore peace and become the kingdom's greatest hero.

Gameplay Elements
★ Physics Movements: tilt the board to move game elements.
★ Walls and floors: Colliding, Movable, walk-through and Bumpy.
★ Adversaries: Path Followers that may bump or defeat you.
★ Dangers: Cliffs, Holes, Water, Lava and Corruption will be hazardous.
★ Natural Hurdles: such as Water streams, Ice, Grass and Bumpy Mushrooms.
★ Family Mode: Cotton Clouds will cover most of the dangers in the levels.
★ Gamer Mode: Normal gameplay with all the challenges available.

Collectables and Challenges
★ Rescue all the family members during your trip. Once saved, you can visit them in your hometown and improve bonds with corn.
★ Win against the clock in Time Attack challenges in every level and earn extra Corn prizes (and a badge to be proud of!)
★ Collect all the Corn within a level and win an extra Corn prize (and again, medals for you!)
★ Find all the music tracks hidden in the game.

Family game mode
★ This mode is a bit slower, takes deathly stuff and adds clouds to avoid falling, reducing frustration.
★ Clouds will be bouncy, to keep it fun.
★ This mode eliminates the visual fear of younger players. (I don’t want to fall into lava)

Accessibility
★ Motion Sick toggle, to quit floor movement on screen and reduce dizziness. 
★ Sound volume split with Music, VO and Sound Effects.
70010000100154.intro: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.
70010000100154.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
